could_change: Could weaken the link from exhaust to outdoor air and roadside exposure on the routes served.
risks: Higher capital cost; depots and charging; benefits depend on retiring old buses rather than adding new ones.
measure: Fleet age, route emissions, roadside concentrations on served corridors.
unproven: Whether fleet renewal measurably lowers corridor or city PM2.5 in South Asian cities.

could_change: Could weaken the link from exhaust to outdoor air by finding and fixing high emitters.
risks: Corruption or weak testing; costs fall on owners of older vehicles, often lower-income.
measure: Share of high emitters found and repaired; on-road emission measurements.
unproven: Whether inspection centres reduce real-world fleet emissions where they are built.

could_change: Could weaken the link from industrial emissions to outdoor air if data drive enforcement and disclosure.
risks: Data without enforcement change little; tampering; cost to small firms.
measure: Stack data availability, enforcement actions, emissions trends.
unproven: Whether monitoring linked to enforcement cuts emissions from large sources in the region.

could_change: Could weaken the industry-to-air link and ease the cost barrier for small firms.
risks: Higher fuel or power costs; uneven uptake; displacement to unregulated units.
measure: Number of firms converting, emissions per unit output, firm survival.
unproven: Whether finance plus technical help changes emissions at scale.

could_change: Could weaken the kiln-to-air link and, with labour standards, the link from kiln work to exposure.
risks: Conversion without trained workers lowers efficiency; worker pay and debt may not improve; closures can cost jobs.
measure: Kiln technology, emissions, worker pay, debt and housing conditions.
unproven: What happens to kiln workers when kilns convert (evidence gap G6).

could_change: Could weaken the links from fuel cost to solid-fuel use, and from stoves to indoor and outdoor air.
risks: Partial switching leaves exposure above the guideline; subsidy cost; supply reliability.
measure: Refills per household, exclusive gas use, personal exposure.
unproven: Health gains from partial exposure reduction (the HAPIN trial found limited effects).

could_change: Could weaken the link from costly alternatives to burning by subsidising machines.
risks: Machines idle outside a short window; benefits skew to larger farms.
measure: Machine use rates, fires detected, farmer costs.
unproven: Whether subsidies alone reduce burning; current rating is limited.

could_change: Could weaken the incentive to burn by paying for residue.
risks: Thin markets; transport costs; payments may not reach tenant farmers.
measure: Tonnes collected, fires detected, farmer income.
unproven: Whether payment schemes reduce burning and protect smallholder incomes (gap G18).

could_change: Claimed to suppress dust near the machine.
risks: Water use of 25 to 90 lakh litres a day at scale; covers under 0.5% of Delhi.
measure: Not recommended on present evidence.
unproven: No adequate evidence of a meaningful effect on fine particles.

could_change: Claimed to clean outdoor air locally; measured effects are confined to about 200 m.
risks: About Rs 25 crore each to build and Rs 15 lakh a month to run; effects too small to matter.
measure: Not recommended on present evidence.
unproven: Strong evidence of very limited effect.

could_change: Could weaken the link from outdoor work to exposure, and from exposure to harm, while sources persist.
risks: Poorly fitted masks give little protection; shifting the duty from employers to workers.
measure: Personal exposure, mask fit and use, symptoms.
unproven: Whether respirator programmes reduce exposure in practice for outdoor workers (gap G4).

could_change: Mass mask handouts aim to cut individual exposure.
risks: Low use and poor fit; signals that protection is a personal responsibility.
measure: Not recommended on present evidence.
unproven: Limited/mixed evidence of benefit at population scale.

could_change: Could weaken the link from polluted air to children's symptoms through protective behaviour.
risks: Effects fade in year two; does not reduce outdoor pollution.
measure: Awareness, behaviour, symptoms, attendance.
unproven: Durability beyond the first year.

could_change: Could weaken the link from outdoor air to classroom air.
risks: Children may reduce protection outside school; running and filter costs.
measure: Classroom PM2.5, behaviour outside school, lung function.
unproven: What purifiers achieve once behavioural offsets are addressed (gap G3).

could_change: Could reduce exposure for people with no other indoor refuge.
risks: Running costs; overcrowding; filters need maintenance.
measure: Indoor PM2.5 in shelters, occupancy.
unproven: Whether filtration reduces exposure enough to matter (gap G9).

could_change: Purpose-built shelters aim to offer clean indoor air during episodes.
risks: High cost; low uptake by those most at risk.
measure: Not recommended on present evidence.
unproven: No studies of uptake by those most at risk were found.

could_change: Could reduce the harm that follows exposure through earlier care and surveillance.
risks: Surveillance without treatment capacity; staff burden.
measure: Surveillance coverage, admissions, treatment times.
unproven: How well services respond during severe episodes (gap G12).

could_change: Could weaken the link from emergency bans to unrelieved wage loss by getting workers registered and paid.
risks: Registration costs time; migrants lose eligibility when they move.
measure: Registration rates, payments received, time to payment.
unproven: Whether registration support raises receipt among migrants (gap G2).

could_change: Could weaken the link from bans to lost income for workers outside construction.
risks: Fiscal cost; targeting informal workers is hard.
measure: Income during restriction days for vendors, riders and small units.
unproven: No adequate evidence found; needs piloting.

could_change: Could weaken the link from illness to medical spending (health cover) and from exclusion to exposure (protective equipment).
risks: Enrolment drives that are not followed by benefits.
measure: Enrolment, benefits received, out-of-pocket spending.
unproven: Effect on spending and exposure is unmeasured.

could_change: Could make unequal exposure visible and give affected groups a say in local responses.
risks: Burden on volunteers; fear of job loss inhibits speaking up.
measure: Participation, local decisions influenced, measurements collected.
unproven: Whether organising changes local exposure or protection.

could_change: Could weaken the link from missing monitors to unrecorded exposure, if data reach a named decision and budget.
risks: Sensor accuracy limits; data without a decision-maker change little.
measure: Data coverage, decisions taken, actions funded.
unproven: No evidence yet of action triggered (see the sensors worked question).

could_change: Could make local sources and exposure visible to residents and officials.
risks: Data credibility disputes; volunteer burden.
measure: Measurements collected, local decisions influenced.
unproven: Limited/mixed evidence of changed decisions.

could_change: Could weaken the link from poor information to poorly targeted action by checking what spending achieves.
risks: Findings ignored; evaluation cost.
measure: Evaluations published, spending decisions changed.
unproven: Moderate evidence for this accountability role.

could_change: Could weaken the link from cross-border pollution to fragmented action by coordinating across jurisdictions.
risks: Plans without shared budgets or authority; slow agreement.
measure: Joint measures adopted, regional concentrations.
unproven: How cross-border controls work when jurisdictions and funding differ (gap G17).
